### 2024 Election Results and the 2024 District Map



### 2024 Election Results and the proposed 2025 District Map

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

sov_clean <- read_rds("gerrymandering-JreamIT/data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec_clean.rds")

cong_by_cd <- sov_clean |>
  mutate(
    dem_votes = coalesce(cngdem01,0) + coalesce(cngdem02,0),
    rep_votes = coalesce(cngrep01,0) + coalesce(cngrep02,0)
  ) |>
  group_by(cddist) |>
  summarise(
    dem_votes = sum(dem_votes),
    rep_votes = sum(rep_votes),
    total_2party = dem_votes + rep_votes
  ) |>
  filter(cddist!=0) |>
  mutate(dem_2party_share = dem_votes / total_2party) |>
  ungroup()

mm_stats <- cong_by_cd |>
  summarise(
    mean_dem_share = mean(dem_2party_share),
    median_dem_share = median(dem_2party_share),
    mean_median_diff = mean_dem_share - median_dem_share
  )
print(mm_stats)

eff_data <- cong_by_cd |>
  mutate(
    winner = if_else(dem_2party_share>0.5,"DEM","REP"),
    dem_wasted = case_when(
      winner=="DEM" ~ dem_votes - 0.5*total_2party,
      TRUE          ~ dem_votes
    ),
    rep_wasted = case_when(
      winner=="DEM" ~ rep_votes,
      TRUE          ~ rep_votes - 0.5*total_2party
    )
  )

total_dem_wasted <- sum(eff_data$dem_wasted)
total_rep_wasted <- sum(eff_data$rep_wasted)
total_two_party_votes <- sum(eff_data$total_2party)

efficiency_gap <- (total_dem_wasted - total_rep_wasted) /
                  total_two_party_votes

print(
  tibble(
    total_dem_wasted = total_dem_wasted,
    total_rep_wasted = total_rep_wasted,
    total_two_party_votes = total_two_party_votes,
    efficiency_gap = efficiency_gap
  )
)
